source.label: Proper-closure kernels at K=2 on functional pigeonhole boards

reviewer: Claude Code with sole fresh-context medium reviewer

claims.summary: Conjecture: for the functional pigeonhole system over F_2 (pigeon axioms 1+sum_j x_ij, hole and functionality axioms, multilinear ring) with n+1 pigeons and n holes, at every proper degree D and K<=D-1, the common kernel in V_K of a set of variables modulo the degree-D closure C equals the common kernel modulo the closure H of the monomial axioms alone, plus C cap V_K. Evidence: K=1 at 6x5 (check:functional-factor-kernels) and K=2 at 6x5 and 7x6, all at D=3 (check:functional-kernels-k2), F_2 and m=n+1 only. Variable errors are load-bearing: non-monomial errors are governed by other memberships (check:truncated-kernel-beyond-support).
claims.assessment: Conjecture from finite checks at D=3 on two boards; a proposed route (unverified) is the dual design-extension form through prop:exact-operator-criterion at D<=ceil(n/2), which stops at a top-layer correction.
claims.rationale: States the sandwich's killing half for the functional pigeonhole system, so that survival is the only open half there.
claims.next_action: Single-error case through its dual top-layer design extension, against prop:blocked-centre-lift-failure.

claims.summary: Exact F_2 computation (three_quantities.py with tools/pc_closure.py) on the functional pigeonhole system at D=3, K=2, comparing kernels of sets of variables modulo the closure C with those modulo the monomial-axiom closure H plus C cap V_2: at 6x5 (C dimension 4056, H 2995, C cap V_2 276) the diagonal sets {x00,x11,x22} and {x00,x11,x22,x33} and the sets {x00,x01}, {x00,x10}, {x00,x01,x11}, and at 7x6 (C cap V_2 469) the two diagonal sets, all have single excess 0, joint defect 0 and total excess 0, with surviving domain killers modulo C cap V_2 of dimension 36, 12, 68, 88, 41, 48, 12. Controls: K=1 excess 0 as recorded; a positive control (monomial axioms ab, bz, linear axiom w+a+z, D=2, K=1, F={w}) gives excess 1.
claims.assessment: Finite check by exact elimination; two committed runs; both controls passed.
claims.rationale: Decides the transfer review's test at its proxy and tests the conjecture on non-diagonal sets and a second board.
claims.next_action: None on this check; conj:functional-kernel-transfer is the general form.
